title: TYZEN HSIAO MUSIC WORKS 蕭泰然音樂基金會
content_html: Tyzen Hsiao Music Works (蕭泰然音樂基金會) is a foundation dedicated to honoring the legacy of Taiwanese American composer Tyzen Hsiao and preserving and promoting his musical works. Maestro Hsiao trained in Taiwan, Japan, and the United States, developing a unique compositional style that blended international influences with a deep love of Taiwanese folk music. His compositions captured the spirit and resilience of the Taiwanese people and continue to be performed in churches and symphony halls worldwide. The foundation carries forward his memory and artistic legacy, inspiring poets, artists, and musicians across generations.
